transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Hi Dr. Smith. I'm here because I've been having a really hard time staying focused and paying attention to things. I also constantly feel restless and find it hard to sit still.

To help me understand your experience better, do you feel that your difficulty sitting still is something that happens constantly throughout the day, or is it more of an internal feeling of restlessness?

Honestly, I experience both of those things. I frequently have trouble staying in my seat when I'm expected to remain seated, like during long meetings or meals. On top of that, I constantly struggle with an uncomfortable, internal feeling of restlessness that makes me feel like I just have to get up and move around.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports both significant inattentive symptoms and hyperactive/impulsive symptoms (difficulty sitting still in expected settings and internal restlessness). As both domains are present and meet the criteria for combined presentation, I have narrowed the candidates down to ADHD (Combined Presentation).
